Ivy H.: Heads-up: Shoreline Analytics (acct 4418) March invoice seems to double-count burst GPU minutes and total is ~$3,460 higher. Customer reported via CS.

ops-bot: invoice-generator job 2026-07-12T14:03:05Z completed with 1 WARN. WARN: suspected duplicate usage aggregation for account 4418. job id job_20260712_1403

Marcus T.: Invoice id? PDF/raw?

Ivy H.: INV-2026-03-4418. PDF: https://payments.internal.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-03-4418.pdf  Raw: s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-4418.json

Leah (Acct): I see two invoice records in Draft: INV-2026-03-4418 and INV-2026-03-4418-B. Neither paid. Autopay off.

Rohit S.: Pulled the raw. The usage-agg output contains two sets of burst_minute rows for the same job_id on 2026-03-17. Looks like the streaming consumer reprocessed a lagged partition and emitted duplicates; downstream dedupe was relying on event_id but the event_id was NULL for those records so they passed through.

Rohit S.: Problem fragment: consumer inserts with COALESCE(event_id, '') then dedupe WHERE event_id IS NOT NULL. That allows rows with empty string to bypass.

Marcus T.: Proposed fix: (1) enforce NOT NULL on event_id at producer or set deterministic synthetic id when missing, (2) change dedupe to use a hash of (job_id, start_ts, end_ts) when event_id is blank. I'll open PRs.

Ivy H.: Meanwhile please put holds on both drafts and create a provisional negative line item for the estimated overcharge $3,460.00 so CS can show Shoreline.

ops-bot: invoice_hold applied on INV-2026-03-4418 by Ivy H. at 2026-07-12T14:12:00Z

Leah (Acct): Provisional credit PC-2026-07-0005 created for $3,460.00 and linked to both drafts. Note added to account activity.

Rohit S.: PR opened: https://git.internal.redwood/usage-consumer/pulls/53 1 adds synthetic_id generation and updates dedupe logic. Requesting hotfix deploy.

Marcus T.: After deploy we'll re-run aggregation only for account 4418 and regenerate. Reprocess command:

billing-reprocess --account 4418 --period 2026-03 --mode regenerate --reason "duplicate burst minutes"

ops-bot: reprocess job_reproc_4418_202603 started at 2026-07-12T15:05:10Z

ops-bot: reprocess job_reproc_4418_202603 finished at 2026-07-12T15:28:30Z. Result: regenerated invoice s3://billing-outputs/2026/03/INV-2026-03-4418-corrected.pdf. Duplicate draft INV-2026-03-4418-B voided.

Leah (Acct): Verified corrected invoice and converted provisional credit PC-2026-07-0005 to official CM-2026-07-0037 for $3,460.00 applied. Reached out to Shoreline CS with explanation and next steps.

Ivy H.: Thanks team. Filing FIN-5130 with root cause: missing event_id -> duplicate aggregation; actions: stricter producer schema, dedupe fallback using content hash, add metric alert for invoice delta > $500. :thumbsup:
